Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value for IC50 activities on target CHEMBL1860. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary on the target, join activities to molecule_dictionary for the molecule, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures for canonical SMILES. Filter to standard_relation '=' and pchembl_value not null. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
